slips_judged.what: Fill bar: the plugin fills at session bar 12's open (10:30 ET), but the text says bar 13's open (10:35 ET)
slips_judged.why: The Mechanism counts from 0 ('bars 0-11'), and that numbering also fits 'at bar 12 (end of first hour, 10:30 ET)' (0-based bar 12 opens at 10:30). So 'bar 13's open' can only be 10:35. Counting from 1 would put the fill at 10:30, but it contradicts 'bars 0-11' in the same sentence. The plugin even contradicts itself: its DESCRIPTION says 'at the end of the first hour (bar 12) ... enter at the next bar's open', yet the code sets e = a + 12 and its comment renames the signal bar to 11. I confirmed the effect another way, by changing only that line of the plugin in memory: bar-13 fill gives gross 172.625 pts and house ROC@30k -3.87 (DD5 $3,777, one episode), real -4.91, exactly the verifier's arm B. Not verdict-changing: the literal reading loses more.

slips_judged.what: Short-side threshold: the plugin applies |disp| >= threshold_frac x range to shorts as well
slips_judged.why: This is a reasonable alternative reading, not a clear departure. The absolute value in '|displacement| >= threshold_frac x range' would do nothing if it only gated longs (displacement > 0 already makes it positive). The Hypothesis also asks for a 'clear directional move ... by a vol-scaled threshold' with no side named. The verifier itself calls it ambiguous, and its blind arm B (R4) chose the same symmetric reading. Its literal-reading numbers are right: an in-memory plugin edit gives 1,314 trades, house ROC -3.31 at the bar-12 fill and -4.71 with both literal readings. Neither changes the verdict.
